island.prompt: A floating sky island: rocky brown underside tapering to a point with a few hanging vines, lush green grass on top, and on top an oriental Chinese chess (xiangqi) board with round wooden disc pieces in red and black, a small bonsai pine tree and a stone lantern. Isometric 3/4 view, whole island visible.
